title: 第二十五章 混沌第二十六章 力量梳理发现
slug: 诡异复苏我以诡异打造世界
content_zh:
唉~！
陆羽心中叹息，如今似乎不放弃也不行了。
若不是在外界，还有着一些人，依旧因为昨日的噩梦，不时的产生一些恐惧力量，不断的传入梦境世界，他恐怕已经支撑不住了。
突然之间，陆羽反应过来。
外界、恐惧力量...
他似乎，也并没有完全走到绝路啊。
刹那之间，那本来是涌入梦境世界的恐惧力量，便被陆羽给截流了大部分。
这虽然让他的压力瞬间增大，但他依旧没有将那些恐惧力量，重新融入梦境世界，而是咬牙坚持。
随着陆羽的心中动念，那被他截留的恐惧力量，便是瞬间扩散开来。
虽然他截流的恐惧力量并不多，但也足以笼罩一两米的范围了。
而最先被波及的，那自然就是他隔壁的那对夫妻了。
刹那之间，他们便是陷入了噩梦之中。
或是厉鬼或是其他恐怖场景，不断在他们的梦境之中上演，使得他们陷入到了一种极大的恐惧之中。
只不过，他们并没有像一般人做梦那样，因为恐惧而自噩梦之中惊醒过来。
而是依旧身处噩梦之中。
不过恐惧之力，也并没有像那些诡异一样，无限制的压榨，而是会根据他们的精神状态，来降低一些惊悚程度。
一个呼吸不到，便是有着大股的恐惧力量，向着陆羽源源不断的涌来，还要超过先前涌入梦境空间的恐惧力量。
毕竟，先前那些受到恐惧力量影响之人，在经过了一个白天之后，就算依旧还对一些人有些影响，但也已经十分轻微了，产生的恐惧并不强烈。
甚至加起来，也就比起刚刚受到影响之时，一人所产生的恐惧之力大上一些，是比不上隔壁两人所产生的恐惧之力的。
而对于这些恐惧之力，陆羽也是对其进行了分流，三分之一融入梦境世界，维持混沌力量的衍化。

另外三分之二的恐惧之力，则是被其重新扩散出去。
渐渐的，楼上楼下，左邻右舍，都被恐惧之力笼罩，大股大股的恐惧之力涌来，使得陆羽缺乏能量的情况，得到了一定的缓解。
紧接着，恐惧之力继续扩散，虽然在超过五米之后，便会持续性的消散。
但是有着源源不断的恐惧之力补充，恐惧之力的笼罩范围，也还是不断的向外扩张的。
五米、六米、七米...
渐渐的，恐惧之地已经笼罩了整栋楼，五个单元的范围，足足有着两百多人。
大量的恐惧之力产生，总算是维持住了混沌力量衍化的消耗。
不过，担心再次发生意外的陆羽，却是并没有停止恐惧力量的扩散。
渐渐的，就连前后两栋，以及左右两边的楼房，也都被恐惧之力覆盖了部分。
方圆五十米以内，但凡是个活的，都在恐惧之力的作用下陷入了恐惧当中。
就连那些蚂蚁、蚊虫，也都是瑟瑟发抖，就连逃窜都是做不到了。
随后，除了需要维持恐惧之力存在的一些力量之外，其他的所有恐惧之力，都被陆羽回收，融入到了梦境世界。
呼吸之间，本来还只是维持消耗平衡的力量，便是变得充裕起来，混沌力量的衍化，也是渐渐走上正轨。
content_en:
Alas~!
Lu Yu sighed in his heart, it seemed that he couldn't give up now.
If it weren't for the outside world, and there were still some people who still generated some fearful power from time to time because of yesterday's nightmare, and continued to spread it into the dream world, he might not be able to hold it anymore.
Suddenly, Lu Yu reacted.
The outside world, the power of fear...
It seems that he has not completely reached a dead end.
In an instant, most of the fearful power that originally poured into the dream world was intercepted by Lu Yu.
Although this instantly increased his pressure, he still did not reintegrate those fearful forces into the dream world, but gritted his teeth and persisted.
As Lu Yu's thoughts moved in his heart, the fearful power trapped by him spread instantly.
Although the fear power he intercepted was not much, it was enough to cover an area of ​​one or two meters.
And the first one to be affected was naturally the couple next door.
In an instant, they fell into a nightmare.
Ghosts or other terrifying scenes constantly appeared in their dreams, causing them to fall into a great fear.
However, they did not wake up from nightmares because of fear like most people do when they dream.
But he is still in a nightmare.
However, the power of fear is not unlimited like those weird ones, but will reduce the level of horror according to their mental state.
When he couldn't breathe, there was a large amount of fear power pouring into Lu Yu, which was even greater than the fear power that poured into the dream space before.
After all, even if those people who were previously affected by the power of fear still have some influence after a day, it is already very slight and the fear generated is not strong.
Even added up, the power of fear generated by one person is greater than when he was first affected, but it is not as powerful as the fear generated by the two people next door.
As for the power of fear, Lu Yu also diverted it, and one third was integrated into the dream world to maintain the evolution of the power of chaos.
The other two-thirds of the power of fear was re-diffused by it.
Gradually, upstairs and downstairs, and the neighbors were enveloped in the power of fear. The power of fear surged in, which alleviated Lu Yu's lack of energy to a certain extent.
Immediately afterwards, the power of fear continued to spread, although it would continue to dissipate after it exceeded five meters.
However, with the continuous replenishment of the power of fear, the scope of the power of fear is still expanding outward.
Five meters, six meters, seven meters...
Gradually, the place of fear has enveloped the entire building, and there are more than two hundred people in the five units.
A large amount of fear power was generated, finally sustaining the consumption of the evolution of chaos power.
However, Lu Yu, who was worried about another accident, did not stop the spread of fear.
Gradually, even the two buildings in front and behind, as well as the buildings on the left and right, were partially covered by the power of fear.
Everyone within a radius of fifty meters fell into fear under the influence of the power of fear.
Even the ants and mosquitoes were trembling and unable to even escape.
Later, except for some powers that were needed to maintain the existence of the power of fear, all other powers of fear were recovered by Lu Yu and integrated into the dream world.
Between breaths, the power that was originally just to maintain a balance of consumption became abundant, and the evolution of the chaotic power gradually got on the right track.
